offering_description.value: Manufactures steel, aluminum and concrete poles and structures for utilities, telecom, lighting and highways, plus mechanized irrigation equipment and precision agriculture technology for farmers. Also provides coatings (galvanizing) services. Products are made in its own plants and sold to utilities, infrastructure contractors and agricultural dealers worldwide.

primary_products.value: utility transmission and distribution poles and structures; lighting and traffic poles; wireless communication towers; center-pivot irrigation systems; highway guardrail and safety products

primary_services.value: hot-dip galvanizing and coatings; irrigation technology and farm management software subscriptions; engineering and installation services

customer_segment.value: B2B: electric utilities, telecom carriers, wireless tower operators, contractors, farmers and agricultural dealers; B2G: state transportation departments and municipalities buying highway and lighting structures

end_markets.value: electric utilities; telecommunications; transportation infrastructure; agriculture; solar and renewable energy

revenue_model.value: product sales: poles, structures, irrigation systems and replacement parts; service fees: galvanizing and coating services for third-party steel; subscription: agricultural technology and irrigation monitoring software; project or contract: engineered utility and infrastructure structure projects
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; subscription; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: fabricates structures and irrigation equipment from purchased steel, aluminum and zinc, sold to utilities, contractors and dealers; service provider: galvanizing and coating of customers' steel products

geography_served.value: global: North America largest, also Europe, Brazil, Middle East, Asia-Pacific, Africa and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: engineered infrastructure structures, coatings and agricultural irrigation equipment and technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utilities, telecom operators and infrastructure contractors, project-based bids; distributors / dealers: independent irrigation dealers serving farmers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental and workplace safety rules for galvanizing, highway product crash-test standards, trade tariffs and steel import rules

notes: Segment composition from memory; recent divestitures or reorganizations may not be reflected.
